description: Demonstrates IVR (Interactive Voice Response) for inbound calls. Customers call in and select options via keypad to reach the appropriate department.

configurations.ivr_greeting: Welcome to Breeze Support. Press 1 for order inquiries, Press 2 for billing support, Press 3 for technical assistance, or stay on the line to speak with an agent.
configurations.ivr_goodbye: We didn't receive your input. Please call back later. Goodbye.

task_messages.content: The customer selected this option from the IVR menu. Greet them: "Hello! Thank you for calling Breeze Support. I'm here to help you today. What can I assist you with?"

role_messages.content: You are a customer support representative. The customer called in and selected this department from the IVR menu. Be helpful and professional.

functions.description: Call when the customer's issue is resolved

task_messages.content: Thank the customer: "Thank you for calling Breeze Support! Is there anything else I can help you with today?"
